title: anisopappus boinensis
intro: Anisopappus boinensis, commonly known as Boin's bush sunflower, is a plant species within the daisy family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits and therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Anisopappus boinensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, contributing to its medicinal value. Additionally, research suggests that the plant may have antimicrobial and cytoprotective effects, further supporting its therapeutic potential.
